Bike shops in Leadville: repairs, parts, rentals

Bike shops in Leadville that do repairs. If something breaks in transit or the night before, start here. Call ahead on event weekends. Mechanics get slammed.

For: Leadville Trail 100 MTB.

Bike shops in Leadville: repairs, parts, rentals, listed

  1. Cycles of Life

    309 Harrison Ave, Leadville, CO 80461 · 719-486-5533

    repairrentalpartsfittingsuspension

    Full-service shop on Harrison: tune-ups, custom wheels, suspension and fork overhauls, bike fitting; rents mountain, hardtail, gravel and e-bikes for the Mineral Belt Trail and singletrack

  2. Leadvelo Bicicasa

    719 Harrison Ave, Leadville, CO 80461 · 719-293-2362

    repairrentalparts

    All-bikes, all-people shop at nearly 10,200 feet, with service on every brake and drivetrain type, tubeless setups, wheel building, rentals and bikepacking gear; Spanish spoken. Closed Monday-Tuesday
